note: Light trigger check set: should-trigger phrasings about a company's internal systems, accounts, access and their security, the threat model and security review of anything built (the build review the Security Engineer took over in 2.0.0), and the user's own devices, accounts and digital security; and near-miss negatives a neighbouring department owns, phrased close to this one's. Used by the description trigger check.

who should have admin access to our company Google Workspace
an employee leaves on Friday, plan the offboarding of their accounts
is it safe to connect this Zapier automation to our CRM
someone logged into our company email from another country last night, what do we do

list the tools our company runs on and who owns each one
we think an API key for our billing system leaked
automate the handoff from our website signup form to the support inbox

is this text from my bank a scam
set up a password manager for me and my partner
back up my phone photos so I never lose them
